title: feat(spec, runtime, lint): an action body refuses in the caller's language through a declared refusal catalogue
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFyg5B2muWbKZjA9phXVWse)_

Fixes #34273

Clause-②: yes (widening) — an action may now declare `refusals` (`ActionRefusalSchema`); translation bundles accept `objects.<object>._actions.<action>.refusals.<CODE>.message` and `globalActions.<action>.refusals.<CODE>.message` (with `….reasons.<REASON>.message`); `@objectstack/spec` exports `ActionRefusalSchema` and the `ActionRefusal` type (`ui`), `actionRefusalMessageKey` (`system`), and `ACTION_REFUSAL_MESSAGE_HOLE_REFUSED`, `actionRefusalsWithoutSandboxedBody`, `undeclaredActionRefusalCodeAtSave`, `undeclaredActionRefusalReasonAtSave`, `undeclaredActionRefusalAtRun` and `undeclaredActionRefusalReasonAtRun` (`data`); `@objectstack/runtime` adds no export: the action body runner answers through `resolveActionRefusal` internally. Nothing that was accepted before is refused
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #34824 — `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` lists the hook refusal key only and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` teaches no action `refusals`; `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` gain the section and the key row here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作（`type: 'script'` 的 `js` 体）可以像钩子一样声明拒绝语目录 `refusals`，体里只抛代码（`throw { code: 'NOT_DRAFT' }`），服务器按调用者语言回出声明的句子（放在 `userMessage` 上）和声明的状态码；译文和动作的其他文案放一处：`objects.<对象>._actions.<动作>.refusals.<CODE>.message`，无对象的动作在 `globalActions.<动作>.refusals.…`。
- 为什么改：动作体里 `throw new Error('英文句子')` 给中文、日文用户看到的永远是作者写的那句；钩子早有拒绝语目录（#26170 / #33214），动作没有。
- 风险与回滚：纯新增，没写 `refusals` 的动作行为完全不变（有对照测试）；钩子的拒绝语与 texts 的已发布 schema 一字不变（共享工厂按主体出词）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/declared-entry.zod.ts`（共享的声明条目工厂，钩子拒绝、动作拒绝、钩子 texts 三种条目都由它造，#34374 动作半直接加一行），然后 `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts` 的 `resolveActionRefusal`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/sandbox/action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`，预期 16 条全过（含经真实 `/actions` 门回 409 + 中文 `userMessage`）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地；需契约复审（`Metadata-protocol: added`）。

## What changes

- **Spec — `ActionSchema.refusals`** (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`): the hook catalogue's twin, keyed by SCREAMING_SNAKE code: `{ message, status?, reasons?, params? }`. Save-time checks: a catalogue on an action that runs no `js` body of its own (another `type`, an `expression` body, no body) is refused at `refusals`; a code, or a reason under a code that declares `reasons`, that the body throws literally and the catalogue does not declare is refused at `body.source` (comments and strings masked, a computed code left to the run). `ActionRefusalSchema` is exported beside the action schema.
- **Spec — one declared-entry factory** (`packages/spec/src/data/declared-entry.zod.ts`, new, not on a barrel): `declaredRefusalEntrySchema(subject)` builds `HookRefusalSchema` and `ActionRefusalSchema`; `declaredTextEntrySchema(subject)` builds `HookTextSchema` (#34374 PR1). One core (`message`, `params`, the plain-text / closed-scope hole rule, the duplicate-param check); the words per subject are table rows. Every hook sentence is byte-identical to before, so the published hook JSON Schemas and reference pages do not move. The action half of #34374 adds its `texts` row to the text table.
- **Spec — sentences and keys** (`hook-refusal-codes.ts`, `i18n-resolver.ts`, `translation.zod.ts`): the save-time and run-time refusal sentences are one subject-parameterised core with the hook exports unchanged and action twins added; `actionRefusalMessageKey(objectName, action, code, reason?)`; the action translation node accepts `refusals` (alias `refusal`), one factory shared with `hooks.<hook>.refusals`.
- **Runtime — `resolveActionRefusal`** (`hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`, `body-runner.ts`, `app-plugin.ts`, `app-artifact-handlers.ts`): the action body runner hands every body throw to it; one answer for a hook's and an action's catalogue (`resolveSandboxedRefusal`): a declared code is answered with the entry's sentence in the caller's `executionContext.locale` (negotiated as a hook's is), its holes filled through the same template renderer, its status and the code on the wire; any other deliberate throw is a fault naming the action and the code. The action's own object is read by the one owner-key ladder (`standaloneActionOwnerKey` / `isObjectLessActionKey`, `@objectstack/objectql`), so a bound action never reads `globalActions` and an object-less one never reads an object's group. Both default action-runner bindings now pass the `i18n` reader.
- **Lint**: `objectstack validate` refuses an action refusal translation over a code or reason the action does not declare (`checkActionRefusals`, nearest code offered); `os i18n extract` scaffolds the keys (`pushActionRefusals`); the compile half of a sentence with `params` judges action catalogues too (`actionRefusalTemplateIssues`, on the collections the action copy pass reads) — logic, an unknown formatter, an empty hole and `currency` with no code are errors at `validate`, `compile` and the publish gate's `action` write.
- **Docs**: `ui/actions.mdx` (new subsection under Path A), `ui/translations.mdx` (key row).
- **Generated**: dropped-refinements baseline (`ui/ActionRefusal` and the `….refusals.valueType` sites; header recomputed 270 / 1135), liveness row `action.refusals` (drilled to its four keys) and the `hook.refusals.params` producer re-anchored at the factory, a strictness-ledger row for `declared-entry.zod.ts`, and the `check:generated --fix` outputs (api-surface, export-origins, declaration-map, reference docs, liveness counts, ledger counts, and the two generator-owned `skills/*/references/_index.md` lines).

## Tests

- **`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/action-refusal-catalogue.test.ts`** (new, 16): the real `actionBodyRunnerFactory` + `QuickJSScriptRunner`, read off `mapDataError` and the real `/actions` door (`HttpDispatcher.handleActions`): declared message/status/code with the body's own text withheld; 400 default and the body's status not read; zh-CN at the bound key; `zh` negotiated to `zh-CN`; an object-less action at `globalActions`; CONTROL fallbacks (no translation, no locale, no service); reason + params filled, reason translation filled after; undeclared reason / code / no code → 500 fault naming the action; CONTROL: no `refusals` answered as before, a crash stays a crash, a host error passes through; the door answers 409 with the translated `userMessage` (CONTROL: no catalogue keeps the body's 400 and no `userMessage`).
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/action-refusals.test.ts`** (new, 29): acceptance, code pattern, empty message, 5xx refused, refused on no body / expression body / `url` / `flow`, omitted `type` accepted, `httpStatus` rename; literal undeclared code and reason at `body.source` with CONTROLs (declared, computed, no catalogue); reasons/params hole rules in the action's words; the hook and action entries accept and refuse the same documents; each subject keeps its own sentences; the text entry has no `status`/`reasons`; run-time sentences; both translation addresses, bundle acceptance and the `refusal` rename.
- **Lint**: `validate-hook-refusal-templates.test.ts` (+12: CONTROLs, three refusals, currency in the action's words, reasons at their own path, one judgement for an action met twice, the stack pass, the publish gate's `action` write with CONTROL); `validate-translation-references.test.ts` (+4: CONTROL, undeclared code with suggestion, a key on an action with no `refusals`, undeclared reason and a reason under a code with none); `i18n-walk.test.ts` (+3: bound key, reason key, `globalActions` key).
- **Forced test changes**: `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` pins `ActionRefusalSchema` as an isomorphic alias (857 → 858, with its history line); `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (a root omit row for `action.refusals` — the Studio form row is a follow-up, as `hook.texts`'s was); `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` (`action` serves 54 top-level properties, was 53; the sample names `refusals`); `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts` (the action-translation coverage table gains a `refusals` row and the real-instance leg a declared catalogue); `packages/lint/src/authored-site-expression.test.ts` (the new walk pass `actionRefusalTemplateIssues` classified). No other existing test was changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Contract fork** (recorded on the claim): the refusal sits on the action like `HookSchema.refusals` (precedent named by the seat); final public names are the seat's call: `refusals`, `ActionRefusalSchema`, `actionRefusalMessageKey`, the runtime-internal `resolveActionRefusal` (not a package export), and the factory module `data/declared-entry.zod.ts` (`declaredRefusalEntrySchema`, `declaredTextEntrySchema`).
- **Serial with #34374**: PR1 (#34545) is merged and this branch starts from it; `HookTextSchema` now comes from the shared factory (byte-identical published schema) so PR2 adds one text row for actions.
- **Not covered**: a string `target` with no body (an imperative host handler) is not answered against the catalogue — `refusals` is refused there at save, so nothing promises it. The Studio action form gets no `refusals` row (it needs the eleven metadata-forms bundles); the reconciliation ledger records the omission, owed to #34823, as the skills teaching is to #34824 (`Skills-docs:` above).
- The `skills/objectstack-ui|data/references/_index.md` lines are pure `gen:skill-refs` output (the generator lists a module's first exports; `ActionRefusalSchema` now precedes `ActionSchema` in `action.zod.ts` because it must be declared before the lazy `ActionSchema` evaluates it under `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1`).
- Needs a contract-tier review (`Metadata-protocol: added`).

## Verification

Every heavy run went under `os-verify-lock`.

- `@objectstack/spec`: 940 files, 28752 passed (the one red case on the first run was the reconciliation row added in this PR, green on its rerun with the pin test, 79/79). `check:generated` 14/14 (`check:test-typecheck` needs `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192` on this box; the default heap OOMs in `tsc`, nothing measured).
- `@objectstack/lint`: 214 files, 9126 passed after the walk classification; `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/runtime` sandbox + app-artifact-handlers: 53 files, 665 passed; `tsc --noEmit` exit 0. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` derivation test 18/18.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): the action runner's `resolveActionRefusal(…)` replaced by the raw throw ⇒ 12 of 16 runtime cases red; the 4 that stay green are the pass-through CONTROLs (no catalogue, a crash, a host error) and the door CONTROL.
- The spec test caught one wording slip during the work ("A action refusal"), fixed with a per-subject article; the hook sentences are unchanged.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 128 families; all ran at the merge of main (116 exit 0; 12 exit 3/1 on the first pass: a stale spec `dist`, an unbuilt workspace, a shallow clone, and two findings fixed in the head commit — `packages/spec/llms.txt` counts the new module, and the new runtime test pays the `@objectstack/metadata` load at collection). After a full `turbo run build` (119/119) and the fixes, the 12 reran exit 0. The per-command ledger at head is on the card's os-dev report.

Taken over by repo:objectstack#3 area o3-J (claim 6948521290 on #34273, seat 2 hand-off 6948316290); L1 delta ACCEPT 6948575381 at `0169fc10`.
